Name: Joja Medical Team Remover
Author: Kichjo
Description:
Morris and his Joja cronies were never heard from again... except all the times they sent you letters after you passed out and they were the ones to drag you home. Okay then.

This is just a little patch to replace the letters you'd normally get from Morris about the Joja medical team with the letters you can get from Dr. Harvey after the community center has reopened. Now when you need medical attention, you can be assured you're getting it from the guy who's still in town.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

nb This is currently English-only; i'm gonna make it multilingual eventually but i'm still tinkering with the most efficient way to do that. In the meantime if anyone wants to do a translated version feel free.
